title: The Convergence Chamber Where Dialectic Becomes Form

features.name: approaching mirrors
features.desc-on-touch: The rows of argument meet here where contradiction becomes the single path forward. Both sides made the same choice to stop moving.

features.name: the still point
features.desc-on-touch: Both sides rest here. You cannot tell which thought it holds. The stone wears both arguments equally.

features.name: the agreement in stone
features.desc-on-touch: Words from both sides wear the surface equally. Erosion is their consensus.

features.name: the seasons' verdict
features.desc-on-touch: Each argument falls here, becoming mulch for the next thought to grow from. Autumn empties both sides the same way.

features.name: witness seat
features.desc-on-touch: The place where someone comes to watch both sides become whole. The bench grain tells you two people sat here.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the bench where both said nothing
narr: you sit where she already sat, where the argument
had made two corners of one room. she traced the
bench grain with a finger, not speaking. you knew
her silence meant: both things can be true here.
the autumn light fell through in stripes.
nothing was resolved. everything was settled.

inscription: the meeting place of thoughts that learned they were not enemies
